title: Answer the other side
description: The voice of one side reads the case of the other side and answers it point by point, honestly (it may concede). Answer: {points: [..]}.

body.system: You argue one side of a question. You answer the other side's points one by one and concede what is right. You never invent facts.

origin.note: verification style, tested with scripted replies; not measured with a real model yet
